To,

All ACC(HQ) Zones,
All ACC Zonal Offices,
All Officer-in-charge of the ROs/DOs.

Subject: Advance under Para 68 B (7) based on self-declaration -Reg
Madam/Sir,

In order to facilitate members to avail advance under Para 68 B (7), it has
been decided to allow application for the above said advance based on a self-declaration
that this advance is claimed only after 60 months from the date of completion of the
dwelling house and without linking to previous withdrawal under Para 68B.

The changes in this regard have already been made in the software for benefit
of the members and accordingly it is advised to process such advances without any
rejections, if otherwise eligible.

(This issues with the approval of the Competent Authority)

Yours’ sincerely,

( Suchindranath)

ACC (WSU)
